scope: Frozen first implementation and evidence only; no parent edits or empirical fit.
static_route: Differentiate the Hamiltonian E=sum(pi_i^2/K_i)/2+V+sigma+r at fixed canonical momenta using 70-digit mpmath; reconstruct all 72 force fixtures, energy exchange and source forces without parent helpers.
mode_route: Evaluate the damped oscillator by its power-series recurrence at 80 digits, independent of the parent's closed forms and matrix exponential.
coverage: Consume all 1492 check records, all 72 off-trajectory rows, 25 mode rows, 24 tracking runs at all 12 sites, and all 48 disturbed histories at all 61 sites. Check exact source/evidence identities and the exposed imported calibration value.
tracking_route: Canonical momenta in Einstein N with conserved dust number and radiation constants, eliminating density variables analytically. Use invertible reference scales for large fields/momenta; do not project onto the exact trajectory. Radau, rtol=3e-11, atol=3e-13, max_step=.04. Compare all sites against both author refinements with the already frozen author tolerances.
disturbed_route: Canonical Hamiltonian variables with analytically conserved number/radiation densities and an integrated proper-time quadrature. Radau, rtol=3e-11, atol=3e-14, max_step=.04. Compare all sites against both author formulations with their frozen tolerances; retain any discrepancy before investigating it.
mutations: Remove the numerical N-equation metric connection term.
Remove the numerical dust mass-exchange term.
Remove the numerical scalar matter force.
Remove the u restoring force proportional to u(4x^2+nu), which vanishes on the exact u=0 trajectory.
mutation_scope: Execute copies of the author's off-trajectory controls only as negative sensitivity evidence. Preserve every changed source, exact patch, fixture, raw result and execution status. Do not treat author execution as independent positive evidence.
failure_policy: All actual failures and executed sources remain immutable; no threshold adjustment to turn a failed comparison into a pass. A corrected reviewer implementation, if needed, receives a new version.
resources: One CPU; small foreground calculations. All writes stay in independent_numerical_review.
